description: The switch round trip (ECO report X1): does `off` put the world back exactly, and does `on` bring the tool back? On -> one season -> off -> state -> named save -> title -> reload with the tool off (off clears the autostart, so no tool code runs at the load) -> state -> on -> casts. Deterministic, one cell per fort. Passes with 0 differences after off (population entries zeroed or extinct against the worldgen snapshot, entries and raws between the off state and the reloaded world, no tool-written relation pair left live) and casts identical after on.
